items.text: Careers that involve travel include aviation and cruise roles, tourism and events, field sales, consulting and audit, research and survey work, and journalism, and the useful question is how much travel the role really needs, who pays for it and what it does to rest and family time.
Choose the kind of travel you want, short trips or long postings, then pick a role where travel is part of the job and costs are covered.
Read the written terms and avoid any role that asks you to pay for travel or placement.
